results.summary_before: This design performs matrix multiplication. The first input switch, when flipped, initializes a matrix multiplication between the current set of inputs. It is a machine learning accelerator.
results.summary: This design multiplies an input vector by a matrix. The first input switch initializes a matrix multiplication between the current vector and the matrix, and the second bit sets matrix values line by line. A counter increases by one every second with a 10 MHz input clock, and outputs drive a seven-segment display. The documentation notes there is no current functionality to know which row of the matrix is set.
